verdict.rationale: Honeybadger has a confirmed llms.txt endpoint (HTTP 200) plus dedicated _llms-txt reference docs (product-reference.txt, insights-reference.txt, other-reference.txt) that an agent can be pointed at, and also offers a documented MCP server as an agent-facing integration. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent actually consumes llms.txt successfully, and no discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec to complement it.
